prompt: A photorealistic, high-resolution selfie taken by a young Asian woman with wet, shoulder-length dark brown hair and soft bangs. She is wrapped in a fluffy white bath towel, holding it securely at her chest with one hand while extending the other arm to take the photo. Her skin has a dewy, glistening texture, suggesting she has just finished bathing. The setting is a traditional Japanese onsen (hot spring) interior or semi-outdoor area. In the background, there is a stone basin with clear water flowing from a bamboo spout into a pool, creating gentle ripples. To the left, a warm, glowing paper lantern sits on a stone ledge next to a small potted plant and a wooden bucket. The lighting is moody and atmospheric, combining the warm glow of the lantern with the cool tones of the water and stone walls.

promptZh: 一张由一位年轻的亚洲女性拍摄的高分辨率写实自拍。她留着湿润的深棕色齐肩发和柔和的刘海。她裹着一条蓬松的白色浴巾，一只手紧紧护在胸前，另一只手伸出镜头进行拍摄。她的皮肤呈现出水润光泽的质感，暗示她刚刚沐浴完毕。场景位于传统日式温泉（Onsen）室内或半户外区域。背景中有一个石制水盆，清澈的水从竹制出水口流入池中，泛起轻柔的涟漪。左侧，一盏温暖明亮的纸灯笼放置在石台上，旁边有一盆小盆栽和一个木桶。灯光氛围浓郁且富有情调，将灯笼的暖光与水及石墙的冷色调完美融合。
